arxiv-2209-04021.title: Radiant toric varieties and unipotent group actions Thanks: Supported by the grant RSF-DST 22-41-02019
arxiv-2209-04021.creator: Ivan Arzhantsev, Alexander Perepechko, Kirill Shakhmatov
arxiv-2209-04021.description: Abstract . We consider complete toric varieties X X such that a maximal unipotent subgroup U U of the automorphism group Aut ⁡ ( X ) \mathrm{Aut}(X) acts on X X with an open orbit. It turns out that such varieties can be characterized by several remarkable properties.

arxiv-2302-00412.title: KNNs of Semantic Encodings for Rating Prediction
arxiv-2302-00412.creator: Léo Laugier, Raghuram Vadapalli, Thomas Bonald, Lucas Dixon
arxiv-2302-00412.description: Abstract . This paper explores a novel application of textual semantic similarity to user-preference representation for rating prediction. The approach represents a user’s preferences as a graph of textual snippets from review text, where the edges are defined by semantic similarity. This textual, memory-based approach to rating prediction enables review-based explanations for recommendations.

arxiv-2304-04847.title: EXISTENCE OF TRAVELING WAVES in a Nicholson Blowflies Model WITH DELAYED DIFFUSION TERM
arxiv-2304-04847.creator: William Barker
arxiv-2304-04847.description: Abstract . In this paper we consider traveling waves for a diffusive Nicholson Blowflies Equation with different discrete time delays in the diffusion term and birth function. We construct quasi upper and lower solutions via the monotone iteration method. This also allows for the construction of C 2 C^{2} upper and lower solutions, and then traveling wave solutions.

arxiv-2408-01920.title: Image Clustering Algorithm Based on Self-Supervised Pretrained Models and Latent Feature Distribution Optimization
arxiv-2408-01920.creator: First Liheng Hu, Second Qiuyu Zhu, Third Sijin Wang
arxiv-2408-01920.description: Abstract In the face of complex natural images, existing deep clustering algorithms fall significantly short in terms of clustering accuracy when compared to supervised classification methods, making them less practical. This paper introduces an image clustering algorithm based on self-supervised pretrained models and latent feature distribution optimization, substantially enhancing clustering performance.

arxiv-2410-07802.title: Fundamental group in stable Morse theory.
arxiv-2410-07802.creator: Jean-François Barraud, Florian Bertuol
arxiv-2410-07802.description: Abstract Morse theory relates algebraic topology invariants and the dynamics of the gradient flow of a Morse function, allowing to derive information about one out of the other. In the case of the homology, the construction extends to much more general settings, and in particular to the infinite dimensional setting of the celebrated Floer homology in symplectic geometry.

arxiv-2411-08367.title: Surprisingly Popular Voting for Concentric Rank-Order Models
arxiv-2411-08367.creator: Hadi Hosseini, Debmalya Mandal, Amrit Puhan
arxiv-2411-08367.description: Abstract An important problem on social information sites is the recovery of ground truth from individual reports when the experts are in the minority. The wisdom of the crowd, i.e. the collective opinion of a group of individuals fails in such a scenario.

arxiv-2501-15891.title: Any2AnyTryon: Leveraging Adaptive Position Embeddings for Versatile Virtual Clothing Tasks DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation emai; 2025; Any2AnyTryon report
arxiv-2501-15891.creator: Hailong Guo, Bohan Zeng, Yiren Song, Wentao Zhang, Chuang Zhang, Jiaming Liu
arxiv-2501-15891.description: Abstract . Image-based virtual try-on (VTON) aims to generate a virtual try-on result by transferring an input garment onto a target person’s image. However, the scarcity of paired garment-model data makes it challenging for existing methods to achieve high generalization and quality in VTON. Also, it limits the ability to generate mask-free try-ons.

arxiv-2506-23831.title: A Schwarz–Jack lemma, circularly symmetric domains and numerical ranges Thanks: Mashreghi supported by an NSERC Discovery Grant and by the Canada Research Chairs program. Moucha supported by the Centre de Recherches Mathématiques (Montréal), the Simons Foundation and by the Alexander von Humboldt St
arxiv-2506-23831.creator: Javad Mashreghi, Annika Moucha, Ryan O’Loughlin, Thomas Ransford, Oliver Roth
arxiv-2506-23831.description: Abstract . We prove a Schwarz–Jack lemma for holomorphic functions on the unit disk with the property that their maximum modulus on each circle about the origin is attained at a point on the positive real axis. With the help of this result, we establish monotonicity and convexity properties of conformal maps of circularly symmetric and bi-circularly symmetric domains.

arxiv-2507-06138.title: Coding Triangle: How Does Large Language Model Understand Code?
arxiv-2507-06138.creator: Taolin Zhang, Zihan Ma, Maosong Cao, Junnan Liu, Songyang Zhang, Kai Chen
arxiv-2507-06138.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in code generation, yet their true programming competence remains underexplored. We introduce the Code Triangle framework, which systematically evaluates LLMs across three fundamental dimensions: editorial analysis, code implementation, and test case generation.

arxiv-2512-10179.title: Assessing Neuromorphic Computing for Fingertip Force Decoding from Electromyography Thanks: License note: Copyright 2025 The Authors. This work is licensed under CC BY 4.0. Thanks: Contact: ashahro@ncsu.edu ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0006-0337-523X . Presentation note: This short report expands a
arxiv-2512-10179.creator: A. Shahrooei 1 , L. Arthur 2 , O. Patel 2 , and D. Kamper 2
arxiv-2512-10179.description: Abstract High-density surface electromyography (HD-sEMG) provides a noninvasive neural interface for assistive and rehabilitation control, but mapping neural activity to user motor intent remains challenging. We assess a spiking neural network (SNN) as a neuromorphic architecture against a temporal convolutional network (TCN) for decoding the fingertip force from the motor unit (MU) firing derived from HD-sEMG.

pmc-10578963.title: Development and clinical validation of a microfluidic-based platform for CTC enrichment and downstream molecular analysis
pmc-10578963.creator: Songhua Cai, Youjun Deng, Zhe Wang, Junyu Zhu, Chujian Huang, Longde Du, Chunguang Wang, Xiangyang Yu, Wenyi Liu, Chenglin Yang, Zhe Wang, Lixu Wang, Kai Ma, Rui Huang, Xiaoyu Zhou, Heng Zou, Wenchong Zhang, Yan Huang, Zhi Li, Tiaoping Qin, Tao Xu, Xiaotong Guo, Zhentao Yu
pmc-10578963.description: BackgroundAlthough many CTC isolation and detection methods can provide information on cancer cell counts, downstream gene and protein analysis remain incomplete. Therefore, it is crucial to develop a technology that can provide comprehensive information on both the number and profile of CTC.MethodsIn this study, we developed a novel microfluidics-based CTC separation and enrichment platform that provided detailed information about CTC.

pmc-10608136.title: Sex Differences in the Atherogenic Risk Index in Healthy Mexican Population and Its Relationship with Anthropometric and Psychological Factors
pmc-10608136.creator: Aniel Jessica Leticia Brambila-Tapia, Ingrid Patricia Dávalos-Rodríguez, Carlos Adán Méndez-García, Frida Isadora Bárcenas-Robles, Itzae Adonai Gutiérrez-Hurtado, Marijn Speeckaert
pmc-10608136.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Dyslipidemia is a risk factor for cardiovascular disease and mortality; however, the association of this variable with a wide range of personal and psychological variables has not been researched. Therefore, the aim of this study was to compare lipid levels and anthropometric measures between sexes and to determine the association between personal and psychological variables with the atherogenic risk index (ARI). An adult population which auto-reported as healthy was invited to participate via social media and in person.

pmc-10650599.title: Identification and Expressional Analysis of siRNAs Responsive to Fusarium graminearum Infection in Wheat
pmc-10650599.creator: Kai Fu, Qianhui Wu, Ning Jiang, Sijia Hu, Hongyan Ye, Yi Hu, Lei Li, Tao Li, Zhengxi Sun, Xiaojun Nie
pmc-10650599.description: The outbreak of Fusarium head blight (FHB) poses a serious threat to wheat production as it leads to both significant yield losses and accumulation of several mycotoxins including deoxynivalenol (DON) in the grains, which are harmful to human and livestock.

pmc-11387610.title: Prospective multicenter study using artificial intelligence to improve dermoscopic melanoma diagnosis in patient care
pmc-11387610.creator: Lukas Heinlein, Roman C Maron, Achim Hekler, Sarah Haggenmüller, Christoph Wies, Jochen S Utikal, Friedegund Meier, Sarah Hobelsberger, Frank F Gellrich, Mildred Sergon, Axel Hauschild, Lars E French, Lucie Heinzerling, Justin G Schlager, Kamran Ghoreschi, Max Schlaak, Franz J Hilke, Gabriela Poch,
pmc-11387610.description: BackgroundEarly detection of melanoma, a potentially lethal type of skin cancer with high prevalence worldwide, improves patient prognosis. In retrospective studies, artificial intelligence (AI) has proven to be helpful for enhancing melanoma detection. However, there are few prospective studies confirming these promising results.

pmc-11481161.title: Extensive pedunculated fibrolipoma of the buttocks that had accompanied the patient for 50 years: a rare case report
pmc-11481161.creator: Yi Jin, Jianmin Li, Jiansong Tang, Zhuoyin Wang
pmc-11481161.description: Lipomas are the most prevalent benign soft-tissue tumours, however, pedunculated fibrolipoma in the buttock is rare. Here, the case of a Chinese male patient in his early 70s with a 50-year history of a growing pedunculated fibrolipoma on his right buttock is presented.

pmc-11489510.title: Climate Change, Heat Stress, and Kidney Disease–Associated Mortality and Health Care Utilization
pmc-11489510.creator: Naresh Kumar, Venkata Madhavi Latha Telagarapu, Alessia Fornoni
pmc-11489510.description: heat stress exposures pose unprecedented threat to public health. When the body’s core temperature exceeds 37 ± 0.5 °C, hypothalamus initiates thermoregulatory processes to dissipate heat through radiation and evaporative cooling. Heat radiation is inefficient when air temperature is higher than the body’s core temperature.

pmc-12622729.title: Idiopathic intracranial hypertension initially diagnosed in ophthalmology: A case series
pmc-12622729.creator: Xianliang Zhang, Hongpei Cui, Hongling Chen, Ke Fan
pmc-12622729.description: Idiopathic intracranial hypertension (IIH), presenting with blurred vision and papilledema in ophthalmology clinics due to elevated intracranial pressure, faces misdiagnoses like optic neuritis. This study explored clinical and radiological characteristics of IIH patients initially diagnosed in ophthalmology. This study included patients diagnosed with IIH between December 2016 and January 2021 at Henan Eye Hospital’s ophthalmology department.

pmc-13217456.creator: Jie Shen, Huigen Lu, Gang Chen, Kejian Fu

pmc-13362051.title: Superfine Grinding of Oat Powder for Filtration-Free Oat Milk Production: Effects on Powder Properties, In Vitro Digestion, and Oat Milk Quality
pmc-13362051.creator: Se-Ho Jeong, Ui-Chan Jeong, Hafiz Muhammad Shahbaz, Ki-Min Lee, Si-Yeon Kim, Donghwa Chung, Dong-Un Lee
pmc-13362051.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Oat milk (OM) has gained popularity as a plant-based dairy alternative; however, conventional filtration-based production removes oat pulp, leading to β-glucan loss and processing waste. This study investigated the effects of particle size reduction by different grinding techniques on the powder properties and in vitro digestion characteristics of oat powder (OP), and it evaluated the applicability of superfine OP to filtration-free OM production.
